name: REPORT-FTG_Successful RDP
description: Triggers when a successful RDP connection is detected from a geographic location outside of Brazil. The traffic must be identified as Remote-to-Local or Remote-to-Remote and accepted by a Fortinet FortiGate Security Gateway.
